cases.name: fresh-own-field
cases.source: interface UI { view?: null; } interface Mouse extends UI { x?: number; } function consume(input: Mouse): void {} consume({x:1});

cases.name: variable-own-field
cases.source: interface UI { view?: null; } interface Mouse extends UI { x?: number; } function consume(input: Mouse): void {} const options = {x:1}; consume(options);

cases.name: inherited-field
cases.source: interface UI { view?: null; } interface Mouse extends UI { x?: number; } function consume(input: Mouse): void {} consume({view:null});

cases.name: empty-options
cases.source: interface UI { view?: null; } interface Mouse extends UI { x?: number; } function consume(input: Mouse): void {} consume({});

cases.name: deep-inheritance
cases.source: interface EventOptions { bubbles?: boolean; } interface UI extends EventOptions { detail?: number; } interface Mouse extends UI { x?: number; } interface Drag extends Mouse { data?: string; } function consume(input: Drag): void {} consume({x:1,data:'owned'});

cases.name: wrong-own-field
cases.source: interface UI { view?: null; } interface Mouse extends UI { x?: number; } function consume(input: Mouse): void {} const options = {x:'bad'}; consume(options);

diagnostics.message: Argument of type '{ x: string; }' is not assignable to parameter of type 'Mouse'.   Types of property 'x' are incompatible.     Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'number'.

cases.name: wrong-inherited-field
cases.source: interface UI { view?: null; } interface Mouse extends UI { x?: number; } function consume(input: Mouse): void {} const options = {view:1}; consume(options);

diagnostics.message: Argument of type '{ view: number; }' is not assignable to parameter of type 'Mouse'.   Types of property 'view' are incompatible.     Type 'number' is not assignable to type 'null | undefined'.

cases.name: no-common-field
cases.source: interface UI { view?: null; } interface Mouse extends UI { x?: number; } function consume(input: Mouse): void {} const options = {unknown:true}; consume(options);

diagnostics.message: Type '{ unknown: boolean; }' has no properties in common with type 'Mouse'.

cases.name: intersection-keeps-both-property-requirements
cases.source: interface Left { x?: number; } interface Right { x: string; } function consume(input: Left & Right): void {} const options = {x:'bad'}; consume(options);

diagnostics.message: Argument of type '{ x: string; }' is not assignable to parameter of type 'Left & Right'.   Type '{ x: string; }' is not assignable to type 'Left'.     Types of property 'x' are incompatible.       Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'number'.
